name: apiKey
label: API Key
help: Your Teamup API key, sent as the `Teamup-Token` header. Requested from [teamup.com/api-keys/request](https://teamup.com/api-keys/request) — approval is manual and may take a little time.

name: calendarKey
label: Calendar Key
help: The access key for the calendar to monitor, from that calendar's **Sharing** settings in Teamup. **Read-only** permission is enough for monitoring; **Administrator** permission additionally reveals each sub-calendar's type and any inactive sub-calendars.
